user.title: Connect to a CradlePoint router
user.description: Enter the router's HTTPS origin and local router credentials. A valid, trusted TLS certificate is required unless you disable verification below. WARNING: disabling certificate verification removes server authentication and can expose router credentials and telemetry to an impersonating host.

dhcp_confirm.title: CradlePoint router discovered
dhcp_confirm.description: A CradlePoint device was detected on the local network. Confirm its HTTPS origin and enter local router credentials. DHCP discovery is not authentication; a valid, trusted TLS certificate is required unless you disable verification below. WARNING: disabling certificate verification removes server authentication and can expose router credentials and telemetry to an impersonating host.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate with the router
reauth_confirm.description: Enter credentials for the same router. Its serial number must match the existing configuration. WARNING: disabling certificate verification removes server authentication and can expose router credentials and telemetry to an impersonating host.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure router connection
reconfigure.description: Update the HTTPS origin or credentials for the same router. WARNING: disabling certificate verification removes server authentication and can expose router credentials and telemetry to an impersonating host.

error.invalid_origin: Enter only an HTTPS origin, without credentials, a path, query, or fragment.
error.invalid_auth: The credentials are invalid or were rejected by the router. Enter a nonempty username and password; usernames must not contain a colon.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect securely to the router. Check connectivity and its trusted TLS certificate, or disable certificate verification for this router.
error.invalid_response: The router did not return supported product information.
error.wrong_device: This router's serial number does not match the configured router.

abort.reconfigure_successful: The router connection was updated successfully.

init.title: Optional location telemetry
init.description: GPS is off by default. Enabling it reads and stores precise coordinates in Home Assistant (including recorder history and backups). Disabling stops requests and unloads GPS entities; it does not delete existing history.
